Reference / net/stream

net/stream#

Immutable observations of the two ends of a connection.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let ends is ConnectionEndpoints<string>=ConnectionEndpoints("here","there");
ends.local_endpoint();  // "here"
ends.remote_endpoint(); // "there"

Description#

Immutable observations of the two ends of a connection. No resolution or connection occurs; exact values and direction are preserved for any common T.
